description: Defines abstract DAO classes and concrete DAO interfaces for various models in the superset-core project, including methods for CRUD operations and specific task querying.

classes.name: BaseDAO
classes.description: Abstract base class for Data Access Objects, defining common CRUD method signatures.

classes.name: DatasetDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Dataset data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: DatabaseDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Database data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: ChartDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Chart data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: DashboardDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Dashboard data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: UserDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for User data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: QueryDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Query data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: SavedQueryDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for SavedQuery data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: TagDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Tag data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: KeyValueDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for KeyValue data access, to be implemented by host.

classes.name: TaskDAO
classes.description: Abstract interface for Task data access, including method for finding active tasks by key and scope.

methods.name: find_all
methods.description: Retrieve all entities matching the base filter.

methods.name: find_one_or_none
methods.description: Retrieve the first entity matching the filter or None.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new entity from given item or attributes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing entity with new attributes.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Execute a SQLAlchemy query with base filter applied.

methods.name: find_by_task_key
methods.description: Find active task by type, key, scope, and user, considering deduplication logic.
